title: Not tall enough
text: Not tall enough. It's only a few inches taller than my big frying pan and I think this limits it's effectiveness. It's also a bit clunky trying to use it on my gas stove as the burner grates are in the way. It's very easy to clean and folds up flat for storage. I just wish it was an inch or two taller.
